# The Musicians' Union

> UK trade union representing musicians across all sectors, providing membership benefits, professional guidance, contract templates, and employment support for music teachers and performing musicians.

The Musicians' Union (MU) is the primary trade union for musicians in the UK, offering comprehensive resources for music teachers, freelance musicians, and performing artists. The site provides practical guidance on employment contracts, pay rates, tax obligations, and professional development across music education and performance sectors.

## Key Topics

- Musicians' Union (MU)
- Music Teaching
- Employment Status
- Contract Templates
- Music Teacher Pay Rates
- Holiday Pay
- IR35 Legislation
- VAT Guidance
- Self-Employment
- Membership Benefits
- Career Development
- Safeguarding
- Public Liability Insurance
- Visiting Music Teachers
- Private Teaching

## Membership & Core Services

- [The Musicians' Union | Trade Union in the UK | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk): Musicians' Union homepage: UK trade union representing musicians across all music industry sectors
- [Join the Musicians' Union | Membership Rates | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/join): MU membership rates and joining options for musicians at various career stages
- [Benefits of Musicians Union Memberships | Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/membership-benefits): Overview of MU membership benefits including legal, insurance, and career support services
- [Contact the Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/contact): Contact information and regional office locations for Musicians' Union support

## Music Teaching Guidance

- [Music Teaching | Teach Music | Being A Music Teacher | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/music-teaching): MU guidance for music teachers on contracts, rates, safeguarding, and career development
- [Working As A Music Teacher | Become A Music Teacher | Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/music-teaching-essentials): MU comprehensive guide to becoming and working as a music teacher with professional guidance
- [Music Teacher Pay & Employment Advice | Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/education-and-teaching/pay-and-employment): MU guidance on music teacher employment rates, contracts, holiday pay, and redundancy

## Teaching Pay & Employment

- [Music Teacher Rates of Pay | Music Teaching Pay & Hourly Rates | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/education-and-teaching/teaching-pay-and-employment/music-teaching-rates-of-pay): Recommended hourly rates for freelance and private music teachers across UK regions
- [Guidance and Information | MU Teaching Rates | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/music-teaching/teaching-pay-and-employment/about-mu-teaching-rates): Guidance on how MU teaching rates are set and how musicians should use them professionally
- [Music Teacher Holiday Pay | Music Teacher Paid Leave | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/music-teacher-pay-and-employment/holiday-pay): MU guidance on calculating holiday pay and paid leave for music teachers
- [Employment Status for Instrumental & Vocal Teachers | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/music-teacher-pay-and-employment/employment-status-for-instrumental-and-vocal-teachers): MU advice on employment status, IR35 legislation, and self-employment for music teachers
- [How To Find Music Teaching Jobs | Finding Music Tutors Jobs | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/music-teacher-pay-and-employment/finding-teaching-work): MU advice on finding private and school-based music teaching employment opportunities
- [Finding a Work Using Music Teacher Recruitment Agencies | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/music-teacher-pay-and-employment/employment-agencies): Best practice guidance for music teachers using recruitment agencies for finding work

## Teaching Contract Templates & Documents

- [Music Teacher Contracts | Music Teacher Contract Templates | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/music-teaching/teaching-contracts): MU contract templates for private and school music teaching compliant with consumer law
- [Private Music Teaching Contract for Students Under 18 | Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/teaching-contract-guides-and-templates/t1-private-teaching-contract-students-under-18-years-old): T1 contract template for private music teaching with students under 18 years old
- [VMT Consultancy Agreement Template | Musicians' Union | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/teaching-contract-guides-and-templates/t2-consultancy-agreement-for-visiting-music-teachers): T2 consultancy agreement template for visiting school music teachers with guidance notes
- [T5 Substitution Agreement | The MU](https://musiciansunion.org.uk/working-performing/education-and-teaching/teaching-contract-guides-and-templates/t5-substitution-agreement): T5 substitution agreement template for music teachers covering temporary teaching arrangements
